authority: User requests a genuine non-outer RL control and longer training, approximately six hours, keeping the enhanced RL discovery.

groups.RL-plain: Reward/punishment TD and ordinary real replay only; NO diagnostic branches, candidate search, teacher selection or KL.
groups.RL-outer: Same initial RL checkpoint as plain, plus actual branches, candidate selection and behavioral Sleep; no feedback preference loss.
groups.F0: No reward packet or Q; real factual measurements plus explicit goal-conditioned preferences and outer loop.
groups.F-RP: Q with reward and capture penalty, factual heads, tested preferences, outer loop.
groups.F-R: Q with reward and no added capture penalty, factual heads, tested preferences, outer loop.

source: Same16genuineV190basecheckpoints, not postselected V196 students. Four pretrained seed clusters, not fresh from-scratch N20.

resource_matching.rule: ALL live training, source/trial, candidate probe, student collection and adoption gate environment calls charged. ALL optimizer calls including rejected candidates/ordinary references charged. Remaining budget goes to ordinary practice/replay. Common report evaluations counted separately and equal in planned episodes. Equal calls/updates is not equal FLOPs or elapsed time; report those separately.

outer.case_selection: First two captured episodes ending<=96 with stationary actions in last8; earliest such action. No outcome-based replacement.
outer.alternatives: original plus directional rotations+2/-2; first replicate original environment/action noise; other replicates resample ONLY future exogenous and exploration uniforms, paired across alternatives.
outer.preference: Need >=2/3 real paired effects agreeing in sign with nonzero mean; all zero/adverse/uncertain outcomes retained. No cause probability network.
outer.adoption: Both fresh32episode blocks have positive paired mean score and overall captures<=reference; ordinary reference and student have same real wake data, update count and minibatch RNG. Not statistical confirmation.
outer.ordinary_data: Main ordinary experience enters each agent own real circular replay and retrieval. Diagnostic actual traces held separately for candidate updates, max128complete traces. Reused prefixes not charged as new interactions.
outer.target: Ordinary target synchronization and epsilon schedule retained; Q train/eval both actual ownQ; F0 actual measurement readout; no extra evaluation-only residual override.
outer.dream: Existing executed trees only; first block both candidates, later history selects order, stop candidate search after first qualifying. Fixed two proposals, not autonomous code invention.

evaluation.strata: Each dev/report bank half ordinary-map, half respective reserved-map, balanced pursuit mode. These are existing maps, reserved within this run, not globally never observed by researchers.
evaluation.selection: No report result returns to candidate selection. Budget/time stopping independent of performance; final endpoint is last fully completed common block for all20jobs.
evaluation.analysis: Pair RL-outer vs RL-plain by source seed and fixed charged budget; report each other full method vs plain, cold baseline, trajectories, late coverage and overhead. Four seed clusters, not thousands of independent models. More training plus repaired design, not pure one-factor training-dose study.

smoke.first_failure: Preserve; no retry or silent source edit after execution.

preservation: All V196 and earlier bytes untouched. New block logs and checkpoints immutable; volatile live status separate. No automation/cloud jobs, no old fixture/native rerun, no automatic retry.
